ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 16-
N in the area bound by:

       the alley next north of and parallel to West 65th Street; South Sayre Avenue; West 65th
       Street; and, South Nottingham Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ____________________________
                                                           Marty Quinn
                                                           Alderman, 13th Ward




Common Address:
7000-36 West 65th Street
